description: Delete an object from the lot by its in-world ObjectID. Source-of-truth note (catalog doc, verb-catalog.md:53, claimed 'no refund' — this is inaccurate): VMNetDeleteObjectCmd.Execute DOES call GlobalLink.PerformTransaction to refund obj.MultitileGroup.Price when Mode == DeleteMode.Delete (wire truth > catalog comment). If you want the object AND its money back into inventory instead, use send-to-inventory. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side VMTSOLotState.OwnerID gate). Object must be user-movable (Sims cannot be deleted this way). Effect: the object disappears from nearby_objects; your balance increases by the object's current sale price. Cost: no money leaves (you get a refund); the object is gone. Wire: VMNetDeleteObjectCmd on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF delete-object --target_object_id <nearby_objects[].object_id>                                  # owner-only; refund applied server-side (VMNetDeleteObjectCmd.Execute)
cf $CF delete-object --target_object_id <id> --cleanup_all true                                       # cascade to all inventory instances
common_mistakes: Money IS refunded (handler doc contradicts older verb-catalog note) — VMNetDeleteObjectCmd.Execute calls GlobalLink.PerformTransaction for refund.
perception_hints: Your balance (can you afford the object?): perception.balance
Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — owner-only ops refuse otherwise
Free tile to place on: inspect perception.nearby_objects[] to find unoccupied tiles; positions are in tile coords, multiply by 16 for subtile x/y
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner (for buy/move/delete/place-from-inventory) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
caller is not object owner (for send-to-inventory/list-for-sale/upgrade) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not the object owner (object_owner=..., me=...)'
required args missing (guid, x, y, target_object_id, target_object_persist_id) → returns ok:false with specific missing-arg error
